meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为群组搭建持久化 wiki 知识库:创建目录与初始文件、添加容器技能、在 CLAUDE.md 写入维护规则;然后按 ingest/query/lint 维护,遇到多文件会逐个处理。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 群组里提到“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等词时触发。

say.text: 给这个群组加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: Claude 会询问选择哪个群组。

say.text: 把这几份资料加入 wiki,逐个处理
say.note: 它会逐份读取并更新对应 wiki 页面。

say.text: 为这个群组配置 Karpathy LLM Wiki,并安排每周检查
say.note: 它会让您选择群组,并设置定期检查。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude sets up a persistent wiki for a NanoClaw group: creates directories and initial files, adds a container skill, and writes maintenance rules into CLAUDE.md. It then maintains the wiki via ingest/query/lint, processing multiple files one at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "add wiki", "wiki", or "knowledge base" in a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Set up a wiki knowledge base for this group.
Add these files to the wiki and process them one by one.
say_en.note: It will ask which group and ingest each file.

say_en.text: Configure a Karpathy LLM Wiki here and schedule weekly checks.
say_en.note: It will ask about group and lint schedule.
